This fruit is found chiefly in cold climates, especially in coniferous forests, and is best known in northern Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains of legendary rarity.

Winclamit fruit, also known as Bloodkeep, restores 3–300 concussion hits. Such an extraordinary range marks an almost legendary remedy: it is exceptionally difficult to find even in suitable terrain. Repeated administration can also lead to habituation. Its remarkable power must always be weighed against its rarity.
